/.title: ShoeMoneyX | AI Trading Intelligence Demo
/.heading: Every market. One mind.
/.description: Explore ShoeMoneyX: an interactive AI trading demo with an animated ShoeGPT robot, crypto market views, charts and strategy research. All data is simulated.
/.summary: ShoeMoneyX brings crypto markets, trading activity and strategy research into one visual workspace. Meet the animated ShoeGPT robot and explore the interactive public demo.
details: The homepage connects an animated robot to a simulated market universe, with coin icons, changing illustrative prices and an activity feed.
Profit and loss, win rates, positions and throughput are simulated presentation data, not actual trading results.
Use the navigation to explore the dashboard, charts, desk, positions, backtests, optimizer and arena.

/dashboard.title: Trading Dashboard Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/dashboard.heading: Your trading workspace at a glance
/dashboard.description: Explore the ShoeMoneyX dashboard demo: simulated account equity, market activity, positions and AI desk status in a reactive blue-and-black workspace.
/dashboard.summary: The dashboard brings account status, market activity and position summaries together in one place. Explore how the workspace presents a trading account using synthetic demo data.
details: View illustrative equity, cash, exposure and position summaries.
Explore activity and status panels without connecting an exchange account.
Account values are simulated and are not evidence of investment performance.

/chart.title: Crypto Charts Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/chart.heading: Explore markets from every angle
/chart.description: Explore interactive crypto charts in the ShoeMoneyX demo, with 15-second, 1-minute and 5-minute views, robot effects and clearly labeled simulated prices.
/chart.summary: Explore interactive crypto charts with 15-second, 1-minute and 5-minute intervals. The blue visual effects and ShoeGPT robot frame the chart while you inspect synthetic market history.
details: Change markets and chart intervals to explore the chart interface.
The public demo generates bounded synthetic candle histories; displayed prices are not live exchange quotes.
Chart overlays and visual effects illustrate the experience rather than making trading recommendations.

/desk.title: AI Trading Desk Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/desk.heading: Follow the decision pipeline
/desk.description: Explore the ShoeMoneyX AI desk demo: inspect sample scans, candidates, checks and execution activity using simulated data with no real orders.
/desk.summary: The desk shows how market scans, candidate checks and execution activity can be organized into a decision pipeline. Inspect the sample runs and their illustrative outcomes.
details: Review sample scan runs, candidate evaluations and activity.
The public site does not run an AI trading model, submit exchange orders or start background trading jobs.
Controls that would change a live account are unavailable in this read-only demo.

/positions.title: Crypto Positions Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/positions.heading: See positions and exposure clearly
/positions.description: Explore sample crypto positions, exposure, fills and profit-and-loss views in ShoeMoneyX. This public portfolio demo uses synthetic data throughout.
/positions.summary: The positions view organizes sample holdings, exposure and fills so you can explore the account interface. Every position and profit-and-loss value on the public site is synthetic.
details: Inspect illustrative position values and related trade details.
Closing positions is disabled because the public demo has no connected trading account.
Displayed balances, fills and returns do not represent real funds or executed orders.

/backtests.title: Strategy Backtesting Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/backtests.heading: Explore strategy research reports
/backtests.description: Browse sample strategy backtests and inspect illustrative results in ShoeMoneyX. Explore the research interface using clearly labeled simulated data.
/backtests.summary: Browse sample strategy research and explore how backtest results are presented. The public demo provides illustrative reports rather than running new historical simulations.
details: Open saved sample backtest reports and compare the displayed research fields.
Launching new backtest jobs is disabled in the public deployment.
Sample returns and scores are synthetic and do not validate a strategy or predict future performance.

/optimizer.title: Strategy Optimizer Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/optimizer.heading: Watch strategy research take shape
/optimizer.description: Explore the ShoeMoneyX optimizer demo with sample champions, candidates and changing research events. Scores and performance data are simulated.
/optimizer.summary: Explore sample champions, candidate strategies and changing research events in the optimizer workspace. The public demo illustrates the research process with generated data.
details: Browse sample candidate and champion views.
Animated score events run locally in the browser for demonstration.
No optimizer workers or live strategy changes run on the public site.

/arena.title: Strategy Arena Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/arena.heading: Step inside the strategy arena
/arena.description: Watch sample strategies compete in the ShoeMoneyX arena demo. Explore changing scores, visual effects and research activity with simulated data.
/arena.summary: The arena turns sample strategy comparisons into a visual experience with changing scores and research activity. Explore the presentation using synthetic demo events.
details: View illustrative strategy comparisons and saved sample experiments.
Scores and activity are generated for the demo and are not measured live trading outcomes.
The public arena does not deploy strategies or change trading accounts.

/settings.title: Trading Desk Settings Demo | ShoeMoneyX
/settings.heading: Explore the desk configuration
/settings.description: Preview the ShoeMoneyX trading desk settings and configuration interface. The public demo is read-only and cannot save settings or place trades.
/settings.summary: Preview the trading desk configuration interface and its available controls. The public demo keeps configuration read-only so visitors can explore without changing an account.
details: Review sample configuration fields and desk settings.
Saving configuration and changing trading modes are disabled.
No exchange credentials are required to explore the public demo.
